title: Soveraeign Seat Message (PROPOSED, decisions/0035)
description: One statement made by one seat to another seat about one operation. The schema owns the envelope only: who is speaking, from which seat, to which seat, what kind of statement this is, the highest standing it proposes, and what it carries onward. The body is deliberately unconstrained: a seat says what it needs to say in whatever shape fits the work. Which acts a seat may speak, in which direction, and what it must carry are semantic rules held in contracts/seat-etiquette.json and checked by fixtures, not by this schema. A schema-valid message can still be an inadmissible thing for that seat to say.

message_id.description: Address of this message. Stable for a given speaker, subject, and act so a re-send does not mint a new statement.

to_seat.description: The seat this statement is addressed to, as a seat_id in the seat registry. Etiquette decides whether that seat is a legal recipient for this act.

act.description: The kind of statement. Meaning, direction, required relation, and standing ceiling for each act live in contracts/seat-etiquette.json.

body.description: What the speaker has to say. Freeform on purpose: prose, or any object shape the domain needs. Nothing in the governed set constrains it, and no checker reads inside it.

standing_proposed.description: The artifact-standing transition this statement supports, or null when it supports none. A proposal, never a settlement: AGENTS.md reserves ratification to Bdo, and no seat may propose past its act ceiling.

aggregates.description: message_ids this statement forwards. Required in practice for the AGGREGATE act, where the carriage duty is checked against these messages.

actor_id.description: Attributable identity of whoever is speaking, including version. Never a credential.

relation_to_subject.description: How this speaker stands to the work it is speaking about. PERFORMED: I did it. INDEPENDENT: I did not do it and did not rely on the performer report. FORWARDED: I am carrying another seat statement onward. This single field is what makes self-witness detectable, per AGENTS.md: a build report cannot witness itself.

grant_reference.description: Opaque reference to the live grant this statement is made under, when one applies. Never the grant contents.

carriage.description: What this statement carries onward. A receiving seat owes every item here to its own recipient, unedited (contracts/seat-etiquette.json, carriage_duties). Empty arrays are a claim that there is nothing to carry, not an omission.

gates.description: The exact transition this question gates, per decisions/0031-transition-local-gates.md. Absent means it gates nothing and blocks no work.

stall.description: A proven BLOCKED claim, per AGENTS.md. Every field is required because a claim missing any of them is a gate, not a block.
